2608.12236.title: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT
2608.12236.paper_summary: We study how organizations use frontier generative AI by linking ChatGPT Enterprise account records to usage, worker roles, task classifications, and public-company financial data through March 2026. These linked data enable a privacy-preserving analysis of adoption, worker roles, and message-level tasks at scale: for instance, the worker-level sample we analyze at the six-month adoption horizon includes over 1,500 organizations and over 17 million messages. We document four facts about enterprise AI adoption and use. First, ChatGPT Enterprise usage has grown rapidly due to a combination of new firm adoption and growing intensity among existing adopters. Second, U.S.-based public company adoption is concentrated among larger, more valuable, and more R&D- and SG&A-intensive firms. Third, active use within adopting firms spans job functions and seniority levels, with especially high usage intensity among early-career workers. Fourth, ChatGPT Enterprise usage encompasses a broad range of knowledge work tasks, including writing, technical work, communication, and information synthesis. In aggregate, these results suggest that firms differ widely in the speed, breadth and purpose of their enterprise AI adoption, and that they are still actively learning how to integrate AI into organizational workflows.
2608.12236.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究組織如何使用前沿生成式 AI，通過將 ChatGPT Enterprise 帳戶記錄與使用情況、工作角色、任務分類以及截至 2026 年 3 月的上市公司財務數據聯繫起來。這些聯繫數據使我們能夠在規模上進行隱私保護的採用、工作角色和消息級任務的分析：例如，我們在六個月採用視野內分析的工作者級樣本包括超過 1,500 家組織和超過 1,700 萬條消息。我們記錄了有關企業 AI 採用和使用的四個事實。首先，由於新公司採用和現有採用者之間的使用強度增長，ChatGPT Enterprise 的使用迅速增長。其次，美國上市公司的採用主要集中在更大、更有價值以及研發和銷售及一般管理費用密集的公司中。第三，採用公司內的活躍使用跨越工作職能和職位層級，尤其是在早期職業工作者中使用強度特別高。第四，ChatGPT Enterprise 的使用涵蓋了廣泛的知識工作任務，包括寫作、技術工作、溝通和信息綜合。總體而言，這些結果表明，企業在其 AI 採用的速度、範圍和目的上存在廣泛差異，並且它們仍在積極學習如何將 AI 整合到組織工作流程中。
